title: How Selling His Apartment Made CZ a Crypto Billionaire 🏢
alt_hooks: He sold his apartment for $900,000 to buy Bitcoin. Then everything changed.
Did you know Binance founder CZ traded his entire home for Bitcoin?
How one apartment sale in Shanghai created the richest inmate in U.S. history.

scenes.line: He sold his apartment for $900,000 and put every single dollar into Bitcoin.
Changpeng Zhao played poker in Shanghai in 2014 when a crypto developer told him about the asset.

visual.event: CZ learns about Bitcoin in Shanghai

scenes.line: CZ went all in, selling his home to buy the dip when markets crashed.
Just years later, he founded Binance and built a massive multi-billion dollar empire.
Federal prosecutors came knocking, landing him a 4 month sentence in a U.S. facility.
Now he is the richest former inmate in history, proving that...

description: Changpeng Zhao sold his Shanghai apartment for $900,000 in 2014 to buy Bitcoin, eventually founding Binance and becoming one of the wealthiest figures in crypto history despite serving a prison sentence in the U.S.
pinned: Would you sell your home to buy Bitcoin?
